items.feedback: Correct. You put the bigger one, 남동생은, first as the topic. You gave 보다 to the weaker side, 저보다. The swapped sentence in option a is the usual trap, and you avoided it.

summary: You scored 5 of 5. You can build and read comparatives with 보다 and 더. You can also choose 제일 for a superlative. This quiz tested recognition. Next, produce sentences yourself. Write three Korean sentences from memory: one with 보다, one with 덜, one with 가장. Then ask me to check them.
